maria: :loudspeaker: Preflight notice — az-east1 NIC microcode + minor kernel bump. Planning a soft-drain rolling reboot across 5 cohorts starting 2026-04-05 02:00 UTC. Objective: apply microcode, validate driver/kernel handoff, avoid hard evictions and minimize tail latency. Details below.
alex: cohort sizes and per-cohort ETA? impact to dedicated pools?
maria: cohort ~= 12 racks (~10% of az-east1 capacity). ETA per cohort 20–30m (cordon->drain->reboot->kvcache-seed->verify). whole window ~4h incl. buffer. Dedicated pools tagged `dedicated-east` are excluded by default — only affected if autoscale backfill can't cover.
priya: need to notify customers / risk SLA hits?
maria: we will post console banner + targeted emails to tenants with high qps. SLA risk expected to be low; small transient throttles/retries possible. We'll monitor error-rate and have rollback policy.
carlos: KV cache seeding — can we prewarm and run probe traffic? any commands?
maria: yes. Run warmup 15m before cohort starts and immediately after uncordon. Example preheat:
```
curl -X POST "https://ops.redwood/warmup" -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPSTOKEN" -d '{"region":"az-east1","cohort":3,"shards":12}'
```
Also run `kvcache-prime --region az-east1 --shards 12 --concurrency 8` from the ops bastion.
infra-bot: Scheduled maintenance created: https://status.redwood/maintenance/az-east1-1811112222 :calendar: (window 02:00–06:30 UTC)
ryan-oncall: I'll be oncall for the window 02:00–06:00 UTC, watching latency and error dashboards. Ping me if p95 > 200ms or error-rate > 0.5%. :+1:
maria: final runbook highlights — preheat -> cordon cohort -> drain with graceful timeout 300s -> reboot -> quick kvcache-seed -> healthcheck & golden-traffic probe -> uncordon. Rollback = stop cohort and re-route to us-west fallback (automated after 2min failover). Posting runbook + slack playbook in #eng-sre. Thanks :white_check_mark:
